source_instruction: find a mattress with high density foam with cover included.
query: I swung by the community garden on my walk over here this morning, right as the group of regulars who tend the raised beds were pulling up the first big batch of summer radishes. They were so crisp and bright red, still dusted with dark clods of soil, and one of the older ladies who’s been gardening there for 20 years pressed a whole bunch into my arms before I could even protest, saying they’d grown way more than their households could possibly eat before the greens wilted. I stopped to chat for 10 minutes too, watching a tiny fluffy sparrow hop along the split-rail fence stealing sunflower seeds that had spilled out of the bird feeder hung by the gate, and a group of little kids from the adjacent daycare were chasing a monarch butterfly that kept fluttering just out of their reach, giggling so loud it made everyone nearby smile. I even noticed the old oak tree at the garden entrance has started dropping tiny acorns already, which feels wild because it feels like summer only just really got started a couple weeks ago. Hey there, I’m looking for a new mattress from this section, and I definitely need one made with high resilience material. I’m hoping to grab one that comes with whatever extra add-on pairs best with the core mattress, y’know? I don’t want to overspend, so I’m only looking for options that are a reasonable price for what you get. I don’t have any other super specific must-haves beyond that, just something that’ll hold up well for everyday use. Let me know what you’ve got that fits what I’m after!
